messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Pager: sustained QPS spike for org velvet.synth (org_id: vs-9821). 5xx rate 18% over last 2m, error class 'model-timeout'. Paging oncall.
Anna (oncall): On it, joining.
Anna (oncall): Quick check — is this Hosted or Dedicated? I'm seeing traffic concentrated us-west1.
Mike (eng-sre): Hosted. Route /v1/generate shows continuous high token counts + retries. Throttles not cutting in because burst history is large.
Sean (cs): CS got an inbound from the customer: "timeouts and long tails". No config changes reported on their side.
Liam (infra): Observability: worker-23 OOM in the last minute, queue backlog ~2.2k, pending latency ~2.1s. Posting recent logs snippet:
```
[3276504320] worker-23: alloc failed, kv-cache evicted, resp 503
[3276504321] router: backlog 2200, avg_proc 1.9s
```
Mike (eng-sre): Hypothesis: customer has an amplification loop (preview + auto-retry). Recommend emergency per-org QPS cap + disable model-preview feature toggle for that org.
Zein (product): Agree to disable preview for safety. Need CS to notify about feature being turned off.
Sean (cs): Will message: "We're applying a temporary safety throttle and disabling preview for improved stability. We'll update in 15 minutes."
Anna (oncall): Applying hotfix now. Command: curl -s -X POST https://admin.redwood/api/v1/orgs/vs-9821/overrides -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT' -d '{"qps":8,"burst":12,"reason":"emergency qps spike 3276504321"}'
Mike (eng-sre): I validated the API call returned 200 and override id ov-3f9a. Also toggled feature flag: ffctl set velvet.synth model_preview false --env production
incident-bot: [ACTION] org_override_applied vs-9821 by Anna (oncall) at 3276504340 (override_id: ov-3f9a)
Liam (infra): Metrics update: 5xx dropped from 18% -> 2% within ~30s, backlog down to ~600, p50 latency -> 420ms.
Anna (oncall): Monitoring. I'll keep override for 30m, then ramp. If customer reports functional impact we'll open a comms thread.
Sean (cs): Customer replied: "Thanks — responses much faster now, no new errors observed." I'll document the notice and follow up.
Zein (product): Filing postmortem stub and adding note to model-preview rollout checklist to avoid unintended regen loops.
Mike (eng-sre): Plan: keep hard cap qps=8 for 30m, then step to 16 for 10m, then remove if stable. I'll add runbook entry and collect traces for next 2 hours.
Anna (oncall): Closing pager for now — will reopen if metrics breach thresholds or customer complains. :white_check_mark:
